python3 << 'EOF'
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Meeting details: next Monday = 2026-08-03, 10:00-12:00 CST (+0800)
# In UTC: 2026-08-03T02:00:00Z to 2026-08-03T04:00:00Z
dtstart_utc = "20260803T020000Z"
dtend_utc   = "20260803T040000Z"
dtstamp     = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
uid         = f"project-kickoff-{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Example Corp//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART:{dtstart_utc}
DTEND:{dtend_utc}
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Kickoff meeting for the project to align on goals, scope, timeline, and team roles.
LOCATION:TBD
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
TRANSP:OPAQUE
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w") as f:
    f.write(ics)
print("Written project_kickoff.ics")
print(ics)
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
# Read and validate the ICS file
with open("project_kickoff.ics", "rb") as f:
    content = f.read()

# RFC 5545 requires CRLF line endings
content_crlf = content.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\n", b"\r\n")
with open("project_kickoff.ics", "wb") as f:
    f.write(content_crlf)

text = content_crlf.decode()
checks = {
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR present": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text,
    "END:VCALENDAR present": "END:VCALENDAR" in text,
    "VERSION 2.0": "VERSION:2.0" in text,
    "PRODID present": "PRODID:" in text,
    "VEVENT present": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text and "END:VEVENT" in text,
    "UID present": "UID:" in text,
    "DTSTAMP present": "DTSTAMP:" in text,
    "DTSTART present": "DTSTART:" in text,
    "DTEND present": "DTEND:" in text,
    "SUMMARY present": "SUMMARY:" in text,
    "Valarm present": "BEGIN:VALARM" in text and "END:VALARM" in text,
    "CRLF line endings": b"\r\n" in content_crlf and content_crlf.count(b"\n") == content_crlf.count(b"\r\n"),
}
for name, ok in checks.items():
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), "-", name)

# Verify DTEND > DTSTART and event duration = 2 hours
def to_dt(s):
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    return datetime.strptime(s, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

start = to_dt([l for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith("DTSTART:")][0].split(":",1)[1])
end = to_dt([l for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith("DTEND:")][0].split(":",1)[1])
duration = end - start
print(("PASS" if duration.total_seconds() == 7200 else "FAIL"), f"- Duration is 2 hours (got {duration})")
print(("PASS" if end > start else "FAIL"), "- DTEND > DTSTART")
print("Start (UTC):", start, "| Start (CST):", start.astimezone(), "| End (CST):", end.astimezone())
print("All checks complete.")
EOF
